news.headline: Delcath amends bylaws to designate Delaware Chancery Court as exclusive forum
news.summary: Delcath's board amended and restated the company bylaws, effective immediately, making the Delaware Court of Chancery the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims and federal district courts the exclusive forum for Securities Act claims. This is a standard governance/litigation-venue housekeeping change, not a business catalyst.

news.headline: DCTH shares hit new 12-month high above $17 after Q2 beat and target raises
news.summary: Delcath stock climbed to a fresh 52-week high (intraday around $17.4, 52-week range $8.12-$17.42) as momentum from the Q2 earnings beat and a wave of analyst price-target increases carried into the following week.

news.headline: Delcath presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Management participated in the Canaccord Genuity growth-stock conference in Boston, using the forum to reinforce the raised 2026 guidance and HEPZATO KIT commercial momentum communicated at Q2 earnings.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright raises Delcath price target to $31-32, reiterates Buy
news.summary: Following the Q2 beat and raised guidance, H.C. Wainwright lifted its DCTH price target into the low-$30s while maintaining a Buy rating, one of several sell-side target hikes that week (BTIG to $21, Wall Street Zen upgrade to Buy).

news.headline: Delcath reports Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M, raises full-year guidance to $104-108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1 million (HEPZATO KIT revenue $27.1M, up 21%), gross margin improved to 90%, and the company posted a $2.7M net income while raising 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth.

news.headline: Independent data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 show 60% hepatic response rate with PHP in metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: A retrospective analysis by independent European investigators, referenced in the Q2 update, showed a 60% hepatic partial response rate using percutaneous hepatic perfusion with melphalan in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer patients, supporting Delcath's multi-indication platform thesis beyond melanoma.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly update will show whether the raised FY2026 guidance ($104M-$108M revenue) and center-activation pace (target ~37 active HEPZATO centers by year-end, up from 31 in Q2) are on track.

catalysts.label: Additional HEPZATO treatment center activations
catalysts.detail: Company guided to roughly six more active U.S. centers coming online by year-end 2026, a direct volume/revenue driver.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 mCRC (colorectal) trial primary endpoint (hPFS) readout
catalysts.detail: FDA-cleared randomized Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO plus chemo vs. chemo alone in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer; hepatic progression-free survival data expected by end of 2027, with overall survival data to follow in 2028. Would be the first major pipeline expansion catalyst beyond melanoma/breast.

catalysts.label: Continued conference/analyst circuit
catalysts.detail: Following the Canaccord Genuity appearance, Delcath is expected to keep presenting at investor conferences as it builds Street coverage; no confirmed additional 2026 date verified yet.

pulse: Since the August 14 bylaws housekeeping filing, no material new company-specific news has surfaced through August 25 - the story remains anchored on the strong August 6 Q2 2026 beat (revenue +20% to $29.1M, guidance raised to $104-108M) and the subsequent run of analyst target hikes (H.C. Wainwright to ~$31-32, BTIG to $21, Wall Street Zen upgrade) that pushed DCTH to a new 52-week high near $17.4 in mid-August. Consensus is now a Strong/Moderate Buy with an average target in the low-to-mid $20s, implying meaningful upside from current levels around $17. Near-term catalysts are execution-driven (center activations toward ~37 by year-end) rather than binary, with the next major data event - the Phase 2 colorectal cancer readout - not expected until late 2027.
